questions.question: Verify the title of the republic-wide collection: the source says Differentsirovannye uravneniya. The English retains that transliteration pending a bibliographic check; approve the exact Russian title and English rendering, possibly Differential Equations.

localizations.source: Verify the title of the republic-wide collection: the source says Differentsirovannye uravneniya. The English retains that transliteration pending a bibliographic check; approve the exact Russian title and English rendering, possibly Differential Equations.
localizations.ru: Уточнить название республиканского сборника: в источнике «Дифференцированные уравнения». В EN пока сохранена транслитерация Differentsirovannye uravneniya; после библиографической проверки согласовать точное русское название и английский перевод, возможно Differential Equations.

questions.resolution: Novgorod State University’s official biographical article gives the title as Differentsirovannye uravneniya. The Russian title is retained and transliterated in English as the publication’s name.

questions.question: Clarify retirement in 1994 alongside the department headship through 1998. This may reflect continued work after formal retirement; both source periods are retained.

localizations.source: Clarify retirement in 1994 alongside the department headship through 1998. This may reflect continued work after formal retirement; both source periods are retained.
localizations.ru: Согласовать хронологию выхода на пенсию в 1994 году и заведования кафедрой до 1998 года. Это может быть продолжением работы после формального выхода на пенсию; оба исходных периода сохранены.

questions.resolution: The unsupported claim that the department headship lasted through 1998 has been removed. Novgorod State University confirms retirement in 1994; the separate move to the United States in 1998 remains.

questions.question: Review cryptarithms as the rendering of chislovye rebusy. The cover retains the Russian letter puzzle MUKHA+4=SLON; the English alt explains the words without inventing an English replacement puzzle.

localizations.source: Review cryptarithms as the rendering of chislovye rebusy. The cover retains the Russian letter puzzle MUKHA+4=SLON; the English alt explains the words without inventing an English replacement puzzle.
localizations.ru: Согласовать перевод «числовые ребусы» как cryptarithms. На обложке сохранена русская буквенная задача «МУХА + 4 = СЛОН», а EN alt объясняет значения слов без подмены её вымышленным английским ребусом.

questions.resolution: Cryptarithms is the standard term for arithmetic puzzles using letters in place of digits. The Russian puzzle on the cover is retained.
